pixel_description: Photorealistic outdoor render only: center is single large white rectangular cold_box enclosure, open cutaway at front, yellow foam thickness visible at front edges and floor, flat roof with corner bolts, sitting directly anchored on grey raised concrete plinth slab. Inside box: two metal side racks left and right with 3 shelves each, centre aisle with raised slats floor, 6 blue vented plastic crates (3-high per rack) with green produce, air gaps between shelves. High on rear inside wall is cylindrical metallic evaporator coil + fan unit with light-blue down arrows showing cold air circulation over crates. Right side wall has light-blue insulated door with metal frame and handle hinged closed. Outside right beside box on small concrete pad sits white outdoor condenser box with circular fan grille plus taller grey battery cabinet box behind it, connected to box side wall by copper refrigerant lines through-wall. Behind to the right stands separate tilted PV array of dark-blue monocrystalline panels on galvanized A-frame rack on strip footing, not touching box. Gravel ground, man standing by door, blue sky. Critical cold_box: drawn as ONE continuous box volume (walls+roof+floor panels as single enclosure), wall/roof/floor panels arranged as closed room with front open for section view and side door opening, anchored to plinth, containing 2 side racks with 3-high crates and centre aisle and raised slats, with evaporator high inside and condenser outside, matching sketch section plan racks+aisle+door and 3-high+air gaps and engineers sketches PU panels 100mm on concrete plinth 2.6x2.6m with 900mm door and separate PV rack.

deviations.why: Main plinth correctly carries box+racks+produce; extra pads are appropriate for separate PV rack and outdoor units per concept keep PV rack separate, does not change support principle.

s1_differences: Partial crate load (6 shown vs full tonne), PV joined tilted array, extra concrete pads for PV and condenser/battery, thin DC wiring not resolved, racks supported via box floor not direct on plinth. None change parts, connections, relative sizes/orientations for working principle.
s2_feedback: No design flaw exposed: white box anchored on main plinth with clear centre aisle and side door swing, indoor evaporator high with down-air over 3-high vented crates, outdoor condenser+battery on side pad with short through-wall copper lines and clearance, PV rack separate on own footing avoiding shade/wind on box. Load paths and access plausible.
notes: Photorealistic view, not diagram.
